'utf8')).toContain(second);\n      const original = readFileSync(secondPath!, 'utf8');\n      expect(pointer(applyInjectionDoor(d, second))).toBe(secondPath);\n      expect(readFileSync(secondPath!, 'utf8')).toBe(original);\n    } finally {\n      if (firstPath) rmSync(firstPath, { force: true });\n      if (secondPath) rmSync(secondPath, { force: true });\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('repairs an incomplete spill left at the immutable path before reusing its pointer', () => {\n    const d = work({ id: 990_004, subscriberId: 'su-door-partial-retry-test' });\n    const text = [\n      'HEADLINE interrupted spill retry',\n      ...Array.from({ length: 400 }, (_, i) => `delivery paragraph ${i}: ${'evidence '.repeat(12)}`),\n      '## Next action\\nRead the full spill.',\n    ].join('\\n\\n');\n    const pointer = (out: string) => out.match(/in full at (\\S+) \\(see its section index\\)/)?.[1];\n    const firstPath = pointer(applyInjectionDoor(d, text));\n    expect(firstPath).toBeTruthy();\n    try {\n      writeFileSync(firstPath!, '# interrupted before the full spill was written\\n', { mode: 0o600 });\n\n      const retry = applyInjectionDoor(d, text);\n\n      expect(pointer(retry)).toBe(firstPath);\n      expect(readFileSync(firstPath!, 'utf8')).toContain('## Section index');\n      expect(readFileSync(firstPath!, 'utf8')).toContain(text);\n    } finally {\n      if (firstPath) rmSync(firstPath, { force: true });\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('kill-switch PAPERCUSP_INJECTION_DOOR_OFF=1 bypasses the door entirely', () => {\n    const prev = process.env.PAPERCUSP_INJECTION_DOOR_OFF;\n    process.env.PAPERCUSP_INJECTION_DOOR_OFF = '1';\n    try {\n      const text = 'y'.repeat(50_000);\n      expect(applyInjectionDoor(work(), text)).toBe(text);\n    } finally {\n      if (prev === undefined) delete process.env.PAPERCUSP_INJECTION_DOOR_OFF;\n      else process.env.PAPERCUSP_INJECTION_DOOR_OFF = prev;\n    }\n  });\n});\n","headBlobMatches":false},{"path":"packages/operator-core/lib/events/await/cell-wake-fold.ts","sha256":"82fd90f964cacc53a1e75ec4e4337b18508e98515c416e3c62058592437d1ad3","bytes":10791,"content":"/**\n * `cell-wake-fold` \u2014 the DELIVERY-TIME reading folded into a predicate wake's turn\n * (state-plane-interest-and-hardening-2026-08-21 P-022, implementing D-007).\n *\n * \u2500\u2500 WHY THIS IS NOT DONE AT THE FIRE SITE \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n *\n * P-001 put a `reread` HANDLE in the fire payload, which fixed the leak that a wake\n * handed an agent a volatile value (`observed`) with no way to re-answer it. But the\n * payload's `observed` is still a FIRE-TIME snapshot, and the gap between fire and\n * delivery is not small: a parked session has to boot, a cold carry has to respawn, a\n * busy session drains its input queue first. The agent is woken BECAUSE of that value\n * and is therefore maximally likely to act on it \u2014 at exactly the moment it is most\n * likely to be stale. Resolving at the fire site would only move the staleness earlier.\n *\n * So the reading is resolved HERE, when the turn is assembled, and stamped with the\n * instant it was taken. The handle rides along regardless, because a stamped reading is\n * still a snapshot \u2014 it is just a snapshot the agent can date.\n *\n * \u2500\u2500 THE DEGRADED PATH IS THE COMMON PATH \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n *\n * A wake is an interrupt, and D-007 is explicit that resolving must never delay one.\n * That is not a theoretical constraint here. The census behind P-004 measured\n * `state:subscribe`'s own inline resolver eval at p50 324ms, p95 2037ms, max 45511ms\n * against these very cells \u2014 so the p95 case ALREADY blows any wake-safe budget. The\n * budget breach is ordinary, not exceptional, and the handle-only degrade is a\n * first-class outcome rather than an error path.\n *\n * Which is why a degrade is ANNOUNCED rather than silently omitted. A wake that simply\n * lacked a fold would read as \"nothing to say about the value\", and an agent that reads\n * absence as reassurance is the false-all-clear failure this whole subsystem is built\n * to refuse. When the reading cannot be taken, the block says so and names the handle.\n *\n * TOTAL: never throws, never blocks. Every failure \u2014 an unparseable key, a GC'd watch\n * row, an unregistered cell, a reader now outside the audience, a slow or throwing\n * resolver \u2014 yields the handle-only form or `null`, i.e. the pre-P-022 wake.\n */\n\nimport { briefCellValue, cellAssessmentLines, formatCellHoist, readCell } from '../../cell-read';\nimport { deriveCellReread, getPredicateWatch } from './predicate-watch';\nimport type { WakeCurrentMeasurement } from './types';\n\n/** Wake-safe resolve budget. Deliberately far below `readCell`'s own ~10s bound: that\n *  ceiling exists to stop a hung resolver wedging a caller, which is a different job\n *  from \"must not delay an interrupt\". */\nexport const CELL_WAKE_FOLD_BUDGET_MS = 1200;\n\nconst PREDICATE_KEY_PREFIX = 'predicate:';\n\nexport interface CellWakeFoldInput {\n  eventKey: string;\n  workspaceId: string;\n  /** Overridable for tests; the real budget is CELL_WAKE_FOLD_BUDGET_MS. */\n  budgetMs?: number;\n  /** Receives only a fresh canonical read (or its explicit delivery-time gap). */\n  onCurrentMeasurement?: (measurement: WakeCurrentMeasurement) => void;\n}\n\nfunction handleCall(handle: { args: { cell: string; as?: string } }): string {\n  const { cell, as } = handle.args;\n  return `state:read { cell: '${cell}'${as ? `, as: '${as}'` : ''} }`;\n}\n\n/**\n * Resolve with a hard ceiling. The loser of the race is ABANDONED, not cancelled \u2014\n * `readCell` has no abort seam and inventing one for this would be a far larger change\n * than the fold warrants. The abandoned promise settles into a no-op, so the cost of a\n * breach is a wasted resolver call, never a delayed wake.\n */\nasync function withBudget<T>(work: Promise<T>, budgetMs: number): Promise<T | 'budget-exceeded'> {\n  let timer: NodeJS.Timeout | undefined;\n  try {\n    return await Promise.race([\n      work,\n      new Promise<'budget-exceeded'>((resolve) => {\n        timer = setTimeout(() => resolve('budget-exceeded'), budgetMs);\n        // Never hold the process open for a fold.\n        timer.unref?.();\n      }),\n    ]);\n  } finally {\n    if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Build the block for a predicate wake, or `null` when this delivery is not a\n * cell-backed predicate fire at all (an ordinary `events:await`, an inbox wake, a loop\n * fire \u2014 none of which have a cell to fold).\n */\nexport async function prepareCellWakeFold(input: CellWakeFoldInput): Promise<string | null> {\n  try {\n    if (!input.eventKey.startsWith(PREDICATE_KEY_PREFIX)) return null;\n    const watchId = input.eventKey.slice(PREDICATE_KEY_PREFIX.length);\n    if (!watchId) return null;\n\n    // The row is the identity source. A delivery carries workspace + subscriber but not\n    // the reader's ROLE or HARNESS, and readCell needs both to run the audience check;\n    // the watch row has carried them since registration.\n    const row = await getPredicateWatch(watchId);\n    if (!row) return null; // GC'd or already reaped \u2014 nothing to say.\n\n    /**\n     * Re-derive from the REGISTRY at delivery time rather than trusting the fire\n     * payload's stored `reread` (D-038 axis 5). A stored cell id cannot notice a rename,\n     * a re-scope, or the reader having left the cell's audience between fire and\n     * delivery; this can, and out-of-audience correctly yields no handle rather than\n     * leaking that the cell exists (P-019).\n     */\n    const handle = deriveCellReread(row);\n    if (!handle) return null;\n\n    const reader = {\n      ownerId: row.ownerId,\n      roles: row.role ? [row.role] : [],\n      harnessSlug: row.harnessSlug ?? undefined,\n    };\n    // WI-6554700010018677: the WORKSPACE comes from the row too. The delivery's workspace is\n    // the coordination namespace pinned to DEFAULT_COORD_WORKSPACE (WI-3575), not the reader's\n    // tenant, so a tenant-keyed resolver dispatched under it reads an empty store. The row is\n    // stamped with the subscriber's tenant at registration.\n    const env = { workspaceId: row.workspaceId || input.workspaceId, harnessSlug: row.harnessSlug, role: row.role };\n\n    const outcome = await withBudget(\n      readCell(handle.args.cell, reader, env, handle.args.as).catch(() => 'resolver-failed' as const),\n      input.budgetMs ?? CELL_WAKE_FOLD_BUDGET_MS,\n    );\n\n    // Both degrades say the same thing to the agent \u2014 the value was not re-read \u2014 and\n    // differ only in why. Naming the reason keeps a chronically slow resolver\n    // distinguishable from a broken one in the transcript.\n    if (outcome === 'budget-exceeded' || outcome === 'resolver-failed') {\n      const why =\n        outcome === 'budget-exceeded'\n          ? `did not resolve within ${input.budgetMs ?? CELL_WAKE_FOLD_BUDGET_MS}ms`\n          : 'could not be resolved';\n      input.onCurrentMeasurement?.({ origin: 'canonical-cell-read', status: 'unknown',\n        measuredAt: new Date().toISOString(), source: handle.args.cell, summary: why });\n      return (\n        `[cell] ${handle.args.cell} \u2014 NOT re-read at delivery: it ${why}, so the value quoted above ` +\n        `is the FIRE-TIME snapshot and may be stale. Re-read before acting: ${handleCall(handle)}`\n      );\n    }\n\n    const read = outcome;\n    const stamp = new Date().toISOString();\n\n    if (read.status === 'absent') {\n      // Deliberately uninformative, exactly as state:read is: never distinguish\n      // \"unregistered\" from \"not yours\".\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    const authoritative = read.status === 'value' && read.source?.authoritative !== false;\n    input.onCurrentMeasurement?.({\n      origin: 'canonical-cell-read', status: authoritative ? 'value' : 'unknown', measuredAt: stamp,\n      source: read.cell,\n      summary: read.status === 'unknown' ? read.unknown.code\n        : authoritative ? briefCellValue(read.value) : 'underlying source is inferred, not observed',\n    });\n\n    const lines: string[] = [];\n    if (read.status === 'value') {\n      /**\n       * P-005 / D-014 \u2014 THE ASSESSMENT PRECEDES THE RAW MEASUREMENT, here exactly as in\n       * `state:read`. A wake is an interrupt: the agent is being resumed BECAUSE of this\n       * value and will act on the first thing it reads, so the first thing it reads is\n       * what the value MEANS, not the number it happens to hold. Rendered by the SHARED\n       * formatter (D-014 \u00a72) so a push and a pull cannot drift apart.\n       */\n      lines.push(`[cell] ${read.cell}  (re-read at delivery ${stamp})`);\n      if (read.assessment) {\n        lines.push(...cellAssessmentLines(read.assessment));\n      } else {\n        // ANNOUNCED, never silently omitted \u2014 the same rule the degrade path above\n        // follows. A cell with no declared assessment means nobody stated what its value\n        // means, and a reader who simply sees no semantics block would read that absence\n        // as reassurance, which is the false all-clear this whole subsystem refuses.\n        lines.push('  \u26a0 assessment \u00b7 NONE DECLARED for this cell \u2014 the measurement below is UNINTERPRETED');\n      }\n      lines.push(`  measurement \u00b7 ${read.headline} = ${briefCellValue(read.value)}`);\n      if (read.material) {\n        // P-021: the MATERIAL answer is a lens on the same derivation, and it is the one\n        // a subscriber watching a high-churn cell actually asked about.\n        lines.push(`  material \u00b7 ${read.material.path} = ${briefCellValue(read.material.value)}`);\n      }\n      const hoist = read.unknownHoist ? formatCellHoist(read.unknownHoist) : null;\n      if (hoist) lines.push(`  \u26a0 ${hoist}`);\n      if (read.source && !read.source.authoritative) {\n        lines.push(\n          `  \u26a0 INFERRED, not observed: ${read.headline} came from ` +\n            `${read.source.value === null ? 'an unattributed source' : `\\`${read.source.value}\\``} \u2014 ${read.source.why}`,\n        );\n      }\n    } else {\n      // `unknown` \u2014 in-band and BRANCHABLE, so the code is what the agent needs\n      // (`not-measured` \u21d2 asking again is pointless, `resolver-failed` \u21d2 retry,\n      // `insufficient-data` \u21d2 supply more input). Saying so beats omitting the block,\n      // which would read as \"the value is fine\".\n      lines.push(\n        `[cell] ${read.cell} \u2014 UNKNOWN at delivery ${stamp}: ${read.unknown.code}` +\n          `${read.unknown.detail ? ` \u2014 ${read.unknown.detail}` : ''}`,\n      );\n    }\n\n    // The handle rides along on the healthy path too: this reading is itself a snapshot,\n    // just a dated one, and the agent may act minutes from now.\n    lines.push(`  re-read: ${handleCall(handle)}`);\n    return lines.join('\\n');\n  } catch {\n    // A fold must never break a wake.\n    return null;\n  }\n}\n","headBlobMatches":true},{"path":"packages/operator-core/lib/events/await/cell-wake-fold.test.ts","sha256":"1bbf1ea91c5fbd19f9a424c3f57ecaaa1e8cf4ce6c3379028c6d785a19964f5c","bytes":17503,"content":"/**\n * The delivery-time cell fold (state-plane-interest-and-hardening-2026-08-21 P-022 / D-007).\n *\n * Two contracts are worth a test here, and they pull against each other:\n *\n *   1. FRESHNESS \u2014 the reading must be taken at DELIVERY, not at fire time. That is the\n *      entire point of D-007: `payload.observed` is a fire-time snapshot, and the agent\n *      is woken because of it at exactly the moment it is most likely to be stale.\n *   2. NEVER DELAY THE WAKE \u2014 a wake is an interrupt. The resolvers involved were\n *      measured at p50 324ms / p95 2037ms / max 45511ms (the P-004 census), so a budget\n *      breach is the ORDINARY case, not the edge case.\n *\n * (2) is why most of this file is about degrades. Each one must still produce a block\n * that TELLS the agent the value was not re-read \u2014 never silence, because a wake with no\n * fold reads as \"nothing to say about the value\", and an agent reading absence as\n * reassurance is the false-all-clear this subsystem exists to refuse.\n */\nimport { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';\n\nconst getPredicateWatchMock = vi.fn();\nconst deriveCellRereadMock = vi.fn();\nconst readCellMock = vi.fn();\n\nvi.mock('./predicate-watch', async (importOriginal) => {\n  const actual = await importOriginal<typeof import('./predicate-watch')>();\n  return {\n    ...actual,\n    getPredicateWatch: (...a: unknown[]) => getPredicateWatchMock(...a),\n    deriveCellReread: (...a: unknown[]) => deriveCellRereadMock(...a),\n  };\n});\n\nvi.mock('../../cell-read', async (importOriginal) => {\n  const actual = await importOriginal<typeof import('../../cell-read')>();\n  return { ...actual, readCell: (...a: unknown[]) => readCellMock(...a) };\n});\n\nconst { prepareCellWakeFold, CELL_WAKE_FOLD_BUDGET_MS } = await import('./cell-wake-fold');\n\nconst ROW = {\n  id: 'w1',\n  ownerId: 'su-me',\n  role: 'su',\n  harnessSlug: 'papercusp',\n  tool: 'dev:pipeline_position',\n  path: 'positions.deployed',\n  args: {},\n};\nconst HANDLE = { tool: 'state:read' as const, args: { cell: 'gate.greenCheckpoint.verdict' } };\nconst INPUT = { eventKey: 'predicate:w1', workspaceId: 'papercusp-workspace' };\n\nconst valueRead = (over: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => ({\n  status: 'value' as const,\n  cell: 'gate.greenCheckpoint.verdict',\n  value: 0,\n  headline: 'gate.consecutiveReds',\n  resolver: 'gitPipelinePosition',\n  // P-005 / D-014 \u2014 the fold renders the declared ASSESSMENT.\n  assessment: {\n    status: 'resolved' as const,\n    path: 'assessments.gateVerdict',\n    code: 'green',\n    meaning: 'the last checkpoint passed and main is fast-forwarding',\n    safeAction: 'Proceed; no gate repair is needed.',\n    evidence: [{ path: 'verdictProvenance.mainBehindStaging', value: false }],\n  },\n  ...over,\n});\n\nbeforeEach(() => {\n  getPredicateWatchMock.mockReset().mockResolvedValue(ROW);\n  deriveCellRereadMock.mockReset().mockReturnValue(HANDLE);\n  readCellMock.mockReset().mockResolvedValue(valueRead());\n});\n\ndescribe('the healthy fold', () => {\n  it('CLARITY produces typed current evidence only from the delivery-time canonical read', async () => {\n    const measured = vi.fn();\n    const block = await prepareCellWakeFold({ ...INPUT, onCurrentMeasurement: measured });\n    expect(block).toContain('measurement \u00b7 gate.consecutiveReds = 0');\n    expect(measured).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ origin: 'canonical-cell-read', status: 'value',\n      measuredAt: expect.any(String), source: 'gate.greenCheckpoint.verdict', summary: '0' });\n    expect(Number.isFinite(Date.parse(measured.mock.calls[0][0].measuredAt))).toBe(true);\n    readCellMock.mockResolvedValue({ status: 'absent' });\n    measured.mockClear();\n    expect(await prepareCellWakeFold({ ...INPUT, onCurrentMeasurement: measured })).toBeNull();\n    expect(measured).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n  });\n  it('renders the delivery-time headline, a dated stamp, and the re-read handle', async () => {\n    const block = await prepareCellWakeFold(INPUT);\n\n    // Keep the declared path and measured value distinct. The old fixture set both to\n    // \"green\", masking a renderer that printed the path while dropping `read.value`.\n    expect(block).toContain('[cell] gate.greenCheckpoint.verdict');\n    expect(block).toContain('measurement \u00b7 gate.consecutiveReds = 0');\n    expect(block).toContain('re-read at delivery');\n    // The handle rides along even on the healthy path: this reading is itself a\n    // snapshot, just a dated one, and the agent may act minutes from now.\n    expect(block).toContain(\"state:read { cell: 'gate.greenCheckpoint.verdict' }\");\n  });\n\n  it('carries the SUBJECT into the handle for a caller-relative cell', async () => {\n    deriveCellRereadMock.mockReturnValue({\n      tool: 'state:read',\n      args: { cell: 'git.pipelinePosition', as: 'apps/operator/x.ts' },\n    });\n    readCellMock.mockResolvedValue(valueRead({ cell: 'git.pipelinePosition' }));\n\n    const block = await prepareCellWakeFold(INPUT);\n\n    // A handle without the subject re-answers a DIFFERENT question.\n    expect(block).toContain(\"state:read { cell: 'git.pipelinePosition', as: 'apps/operator/x.ts' }\");\n  });\n\n  it(\"reads with the WATCH ROW's identity \u2014 the delivery carries no role or harness\", async () => {\n    await prepareCellWakeFold(INPUT);\n\n    const [, reader, env] = readCellMock.mock.calls[0];\n    expect(reader).toEqual({ ownerId: 'su-me', roles: ['su'], harnessSlug: 'papercusp' });\n    expect(env).toEqual({ workspaceId: 'papercusp-workspace', harnessSlug: 'papercusp', role: 'su' });\n  });\n\n  // WI-6554700010018677: a real delivery carries the coordination namespace ('default'), not\n  // the reader's tenant. The watch row is stamped with the tenant at registration.\n  it(\"reads under the WATCH ROW's tenant, not the delivery's coordination namespace\", async () => {\n    getPredicateWatchMock.mockResolvedValue({ ...ROW, workspaceId: 'tenant-ws' });\n\n    await prepareCellWakeFold({ eventKey: 'predicate:w1', workspaceId: 'default' });\n\n    const [, , env] = readCellMock.mock.calls[0];\n    expect(env).toEqual({ workspaceId: 'tenant-ws', harnessSlug: 'papercusp', role: 'su' });\n  });\n\n  it('re-derives the cell from the REGISTRY at delivery time, not from the fire payload', async () => {\n    await prepareCellWakeFold(INPUT);\n\n    // Trusting a stored cell id cannot notice a rename, a re-scope, or the reader\n    // leaving the audience between fire and delivery. Re-deriving can.\n    expect(deriveCellRereadMock).toHaveBeenCalledWith(ROW);\n  });\n\n  it('surfaces the MATERIAL path when the cell declares one (P-021)', async () => {\n    readCellMock.mockResolvedValue(valueRead({ material: { path: 'gate.red', value: 3 } }));\n\n    const block = await prepareCellWakeFold(INPUT);\n\n    expect(block).toContain('material \u00b7 gate.red = 3');\n  });\n\n  it('renders the ASSESSMENT before the raw measurement, with its meaning and safe action', async () => {\n    const block = await prepareCellWakeFold(INPUT);\n\n    expect(block).toContain('assessment \u00b7 green \u2014 the last checkpoint passed and main is fast-forwarding');\n    expect(block).toContain('safe action \u00b7 Proceed; no gate repair is needed.');\n    expect(block).toContain('evidence \u00b7 verdictProvenance.mainBehindStaging = false');\n\n    // P-005's ORDERING claim, asserted as an ordering rather than as two memberships.\n    // A wake is an interrupt: the agent acts on the first thing it reads, so the\n    // meaning has to precede the number rather than merely accompany it.\n    expect(block!.indexOf('assessment \u00b7 green')).toBeLessThan(block!.indexOf('measurement \u00b7 gate.consecutiveReds'));\n  });\n\n  it('reports DRIFTED evidence as missing, never as measured null agreement', async () => {\n    readCellMock.mockResolvedValue(\n      valueRead({\n        assessment: {\n          status: 'resolved' as const,\n          path: 'assessments.gateVerdict',\n          code: 'green',\n          meaning: 'the last checkpoint passed',\n          safeAction: 'Proceed.',\n          evidence: [{ path: 'verdictProvenance.mainBehindStaging', value: null, drifted: true }],\n        },\n      }),\n    );\n\n    const block = await prepareCellWakeFold(INPUT);\n\n    expect(block).toContain('registration drift');\n    expect(block).toContain('ABSENT from the resolver result');\n    // MISSING is not a measured null \u2014 collapsing the two is the defect this plan exists\n    // to close, and rendering `= null` here would do exactly that.\n    expect(block).not.toContain('mainBehindStaging = null');\n  });\n\n  it('reports DOOR-TRUNCATED evidence as unattributable, distinct from drift', async () => {\n    readCellMock.mockResolvedValue(\n      valueRead({\n        assessment: {\n          status: 'resolved' as const,\n          path: 'assessments.gateVerdict',\n          code: 'green',\n          meaning: 'the last checkpoint passed',\n          safeAction: 'Proceed.',\n          evidence: [{ path: 'serving.startedSinceCodeChange', value: null, truncatedByDoor: true }],\n        },\n      }),\n    );\n\n    const block = await prepareCellWakeFold(INPUT);\n\n    expect(block).toContain('TRUNCATED IN TRANSIT');\n    expect(block).toContain('unattributable');\n    // Truncation and drift demand OPPOSITE responses \u2014 re-read vs fix the registration \u2014\n    // so the renderer must never report one as the other.\n    expect(block).not.toContain('registration drift');\n  });\n\n  it('renders an UNAVAILABLE assessment loudly and preserves the door full-read lever', async () => {\n    readCellMock.mockResolvedValue(\n      valueRead({\n        assessment: {\n          status: 'unavailable' as const,\n          path: 'assessments.gateVerdict',\n          code: null,\n          meaning: null,\n          safeAction: 'Do not treat the value below as a verdict.',\n          evidence: [],\n          unknown: { code: 'not-measured' as const },\n          truncatedByDoor: true,\n          fullRead: { tool: 'dev:pipeline_position', args: { path: 'x.ts' } },\n        },\n      }),\n    );\n\n    const block = await prepareCellWakeFold(INPUT);\n\n    expect(block).toContain('UNINTERPRETED');\n    expect(block).toContain('unattributable');\n    expect(block).toContain('Do not treat the value below as a verdict.');\n    // The door's escape hatch remains: when the payload\n    // truncated ITSELF, the untruncated re-read is the one useful next move.\n    expect(block).toContain('full read \u00b7 {\"tool\":\"dev:pipeline_position\"');\n  });\n\n  it('hoists a NON-AUTHORITATIVE reading where it cannot be skipped', async () => {\n    const measured = vi.fn();\n    readCellMock.mockResolvedValue(\n      valueRead({ source: { value: 'run-probe', authoritative: false, why: 'inferred from the checkout HEAD' } }),\n    );\n\n    const block = await prepareCellWakeFold({ ...INPUT, onCurrentMeasurement: measured });\n\n    expect(block).toContain('INFERRED, not observed');\n    expect(block).toContain('inferred from the checkout HEAD');\n    expect(measured).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();\n    expect(measured).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ origin: 'canonical-cell-read', status: 'unknown',\n      measuredAt: expect.any(String), source: 'gate.greenCheckpoint.verdict',\n      summary: 'underlying source is inferred, not observed' });\n    expect(Number.isFinite(Date.parse(measured.mock.calls[0][0].measuredAt))).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('reports UNKNOWN by its branchable code rather than omitting the block', async () => {\n    const measured = vi.fn();\n    readCellMock.mockResolvedValue({\n      status: 'unknown',\n      cell: 'gate.greenCheckpoint.verdict',\n      unknown: { code: 'resolver-failed', detail: 'git rev-parse died' },\n    });\n\n    const block = await prepareCellWakeFold({ ...INPUT, onCurrentMeasurement: measured });\n\n    // The code is what the agent branches 'gate.greenCheckpoint.verdict', summary: 'could not be resolved' });\n    expect(Number.isFinite(Date.parse(measured.mock.calls[0][0].measuredAt))).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('the two degrade reasons are DISTINGUISHABLE in the transcript', async () => {\n    readCellMock.mockReturnValue(new Promise(() => {}));\n    const slow = await prepareCellWakeFold({ ...INPUT, budgetMs: 20 });\n deliberately \u2014 a hand-rolled\n    // watch:create on the same (tool, path) must not learn the cell exists.\n    deriveCellRereadMock.mockReturnValue(undefined);\n    expect(await });\n});\n","headBlobMatches":false},{"path":"packages/operator-core/lib/events/await/types.ts","sha256":"e0ca89e96375de555c740569ce0e0aa27e9d7a8a80d25f36100bd288553a8bde","bytes":20688,"content":"/**\n * await-event primitive \u2014 shared types (await-event-primitive-2026-06-05).\n *\n * The layering (plan D-001): SOURCES resolve who an event concerns and call\n * `emitAwaitedEvent`; the DELIVERY layer here is dumb and uniform \u2014 deliver\n * event E to its addressed recipients, honoring each recipient's declared\n * policy (`wake` = re-invoke me, `notify` = put it in my coord inbox). No\n * cardinality lives in the primitive: a lock grants to ONE waiter by emitting\n * a targeted `lock:grant:<ticket>` key; CI-green broadcasts; both are plain\n * emits here.\n */\n\n// Type-only: turn-proof.ts imports a VALUE from this module, so a value import back would cycle.\nimport type { TurnProof } from './turn-proof';\n\n/** How a fired event reaches a subscriber (plan D-002). `announce` (EI-9270) is\n *  NOT a delivery policy: it marks an emitter-side DECLARATION row (\"this gate\n *  key WILL fire \u2014 await it\") that never wakes anyone itself; every delivery\n *  path excludes it, and the real emit stamps its `fired_at` as the LATCH. */\nexport type AwaitPolicy = 'wake' | 'notify' | 'announce';\n\n/**\n * Reserved note prefix written only by `coord:await-inbox` to distinguish its\n * deliberate idle park from the automatically armed inbox-wake keepalive.\n * Keep this in the shared await types so every reader uses the same byte-level\n * marker without importing a lifecycle module back into the store.\n */\nexport const EXPLICIT_PARK_NOTE_MARKER = '[coord:await-inbox:explicit-park]';\n\n/** The always-armed per-agent self-wake key prefix (turn-lifecycle-control) \u2014\n *  every live agent holds one, so it signals liveness, NOT a deliberate bench.\n *  Defined here (dependency-free) so liveness readers outside the await store \u2014\n *  e.g. the claim reaper's warm-dead leg \u2014 share the byte-level prefix without\n *  importing the store; `store.ts` re-exports it under the same name. */\nexport const INBOX_WAKE_KEY_PREFIX = 'coord:inbox-wake:';\n\nexport function isExplicitParkNote(note: string | null | undefined): boolean {\n  return note?.startsWith(EXPLICIT_PARK_NOTE_MARKER) === true;\n}\n\n/** What happens when an await's deadline passes without the event (D-009):\n *  `wake` = synthesize a timeout wake (the agent learns the event did NOT\n *  happen \u2014 as actionable as the event itself for a blocked agent);\n *  `expire` = lapse silently (visible in events:status, no turn spent). */\nexport type TimeoutBehavior = 'expire' | 'wake';\n\n/**\n * Why an automatically/suggested-armed watch exists. Manual awaits leave this\n * null: their lifecycle remains caller-owned. Bound watches are retired when\n * the state named here dies, and the same object is folded into their wake\n * payload so the recipient can attribute (and cancel) the machinery.\n */\nexport interface LifecycleBinding {\n  kind: string;\n  ref: string;\n}\n\n/** A declaration tried to reuse an active logical-gate identity on another key. */\nexport class LogicalGateConflictError extends Error {\n  readonly code = 'logical_gate_conflict' as const;\n  override readonly name = 'LogicalGateConflictError';\n\n  constructor(readonly logicalGateKey: string, readonly existingEventKey: string) {\n    super(`logical gate '${logicalGateKey}' is already announced on event key '${existingEventKey}'`);\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * The fallback timeout-wake window: the default deadline for a one-shot wake\n * await when the caller names none (await-timeout-fallback-defaults-2026-07-03).\n *\n * The fallback exists so an agent BLOCKED on an event that never fires is\n * auto-woken (a `timeout` wake, `fired_reason='timeout'`) to re-orient, instead\n * of hanging until a human notices. It was 4h \u2014 far below the owner's actual\n * check-in cadence, so blocked agents sat dead for hours. 30min matches \"a human\n * would have looked by now\". This is the ONE source of truth: events:await,\n * watch:create, and the events sugar verbs all import it (it replaced three\n * duplicated `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SEC = 4 * 60 * 60` copies).\n */\nexport const AWAIT_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SEC = 30 * 60; // 30min\n\n/** Hard cap on a caller-supplied await deadline \u2014 shared by every await surface. */\nexport const AWAIT_MAX_TIMEOUT_SEC = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60; // 7d\n\n/** The session wake-handle stamped onto an await at registration (D-003 \u2014\n *  it cannot be fetched at fire time; the agent is asleep). */\nexport type WakeHandle =\n  | {\n      kind: 'adv-session';\n      /** harness_shared.adv_sessions.id \u2014 re-read at fire time for fresh pid/ended. */\n      advSessionId: number;\n      /** Which agent CLI backs the session ('claude' | 'codex' | 'omp'). */\n      agent: string | null;\n      /** The agent's NATIVE session id (claude UUID) \u2014 required for an exact\n       *  claude resume. NEVER fall back to `--continue` on the shared tree:\n       *  most sessions share one cwd, so most-recent-in-cwd resumes the WRONG\n       *  agent's conversation. */\n      sessionId: string | null;\n      ompThreadId: string | null;\n      cwd: string | null;\n      pid: number | null;\n    }\n  | {\n      kind: 'plan-run';\n      /** harness_shared.plan_runs.id \u2014 woken via the plans:resume path. */\n      runId: number;\n    };\n\nexport interface AwaitRow {\n  id: number;\n  /** Number of pending rows retired atomically by this registration. Present\n   *  only when registerAwait was called with supersedePending. */\n  supersededPendingCount?: number;\n  workspaceId: string;\n  subscriberId: string;\n  eventKey: string;\n  policy: AwaitPolicy;\n  note: string | null;\n  /** True when `coord:await-inbox` deliberately parked on this standing inbox-wake row. */\n  explicitPark?: boolean;\n  wakeHandle: WakeHandle | null;\n  timeoutBehavior: TimeoutBehavior;\n  expiresTs: string | null;\n  createdAt: string;\n  firedAt: string | null;\n  firedReason: string | null;\n  cancelledAt: string | null;\n  /** Why an active await was cancelled, when the cancellation came from a\n   *  user-facing control surface. Internal lifecycle cleanup leaves this null. */\n  cancelReason: string | null;\n  /** Cardinality (unify-watch-primitive D-001): true = one-shot (fires once,\n   *  auto-consumes via fired_at \u2014 today's await); false = standing watch (a fire\n   *  queues a delivery WITHOUT consuming the row \u2014 the pot-style recurring wake). */\n  once: boolean;\n  /** Per-subscriber wake floor for this watch's wakes, in seconds. null/0 = no floor\n   *  (one-shot grants wake promptly); >0 throttles a recurring wake:true watch. */\n  minSleepSec: number | null;\n  /** A watch whose wakes ALWAYS bypass the floor (a human-message / escalation watch).\n   *  OR'd with the emit-time urgent flag onto each delivery. */\n  urgency: boolean;\n  /** EI-8998: optional predicate evaluated against the emitted PAYLOAD (a\n   *  @papercusp/rules DataCondition \u2014 the same MatchMap vocabulary as an ECA\n   *  rule's `when`), in ADDITION to the key/pattern match. null = no payload\n   *  predicate (today's behavior, unchanged fast path). */\n  payloadFilter: unknown | null;\n  /** Interest-machinery lifecycle owner. Null/undefined on manually armed rows. */\n  boundTo?: LifecycleBinding | null;\n  /** EI-9270 (announced gate events): DISCOVERY scope of a policy='announce' row \u2014\n   *  who sees the declaration in events:catalog / coord:orient ('fleet'|'plan'|\n   *  'harness'|'global'). null on ordinary awaits. The rendezvous plane itself\n   *  stays flat (WI-3575); this scopes visibility only. */\n  scopeKind: string | null;\n  /** The fleet/plan/harness slug for scopeKind; null for 'global' / ordinary rows. */\n  scopeRef: string | null;\n  /** P-018: monotonic generation of an announced event key. Null on ordinary\n   *  waiter rows; generation N is superseded when N+1 is declared. */\n  causalGeneration?: number | null;\n  /** Stable identity for the logical gate represented by an announced route. */\n  logicalGateKey?: string | null;\n  /** Optional completion condition declared by the gate emitter. */\n  expectedCondition?: unknown | null;\n  /** A newer announcement generation replaced this row. */\n  supersededAt?: string | null;\n  /** Source/owner that fired this announced generation, when known. */\n  firedBy?: string | null;\n  /** Emit payload captured on the announcement latch for expectation checks. */\n  firedPayload?: unknown | null;\n  /** composable-event-awaits-2026-07-11 (migration 572): a composed-await LEAF carries the\n   *  parent threshold NODE it propagates its claim to (event_await_nodes.id) instead of waking.\n   *  null on an ordinary await AND on a tree's root-anchor row (which has root_id but no node_id).\n   *  OPTIONAL (like eventSubscribers on EmitResult) so hand-built AwaitRow test literals that\n   *  predate the composed columns stay valid \u2014 mapAwait always populates it (`?? null`), and the\n   *  only consumer (`a.nodeId != null`) treats undefined identically to null. */\n  nodeId?: number | null;\n  /** The tree this row belongs to (root node id); null on an ordinary await. Set on BOTH the\n   *  leaves and the root-anchor row, so a single root_id-scoped statement voids the whole tree. */\n  rootId?: number | null;\n  /** When this leaf claimed as a tree member (it propagated instead of waking); null until then. */\n  memberFiredAt?: string | null;\n  /** The emit payload captured at leaf fire \u2192 folded into the root wake's { fired: leaf\u2192payload }. */\n  memberPayload?: unknown | null;\n  /** Verified-wait fallback metadata; null keeps legacy timeout semantics. */\n  producerHealthCertificate?: import('./verified-wait').ProducerHealthCertificate | null;\n  /** Last diagnosed timeout outcome, retained for status/leader evidence. */\n  timeoutVerification?: import('./verified-wait').VerifiedWaitTimeoutResult | null;\n  /** Internal lease preventing two sweepers from verifying the same due row. */\n  verificationClaimedAt?: string | null;\n}\n\nexport type DeliveryStatus = 'pending' | 'parked' | 'delivering' | 'delivered' | 'dropped' | 'dead';\n\n/** The wake channel that (eventually) carried a delivery \u2014 also the meter's\n *  per-wake attribution dimension (D-007). `coalesced` = this delivery folded into\n *  another wake for the same subscriber (no turn spent \u2014 unify-watch-primitive P-005). */\nexport type WakeChannel =\n  | 'pty-inject'\n  | 'psu-socket-inject'\n  // su-cold-auto-mode-2026-07-03 Phase 2: a COLD loop wake injects a fresh-context\n  // RESET-CONTEXT (`/clear` in place, keep the MCP warm) or a periodic RECYCLE\n  // (kill+respawn the psu host) carrying the carry-note, instead of a warm\n  // `mode:'turn'` inject. Both re-invoke the agent (it re-derives from the note), so\n  // both join WAKE_TURN_CHANNELS below. Dormant until a caller wires coldAutoEnabled.\n  | 'psu-socket-reset'\n  | 'psu-socket-recycle'\n  // WI-6862: the SAME delivery as the two above, except the host never ACKed it \u2014 the write\n  // only got the optimistic bare-close fallback, which also covers a host that crashed or was\n  // killed mid-delivery (what a provider usage-limit wall does to a respawn). Booked distinctly\n  // so `loop:status.lastWakeChannel` / event_wake_deliveries stop reporting an unconfirmed\n  // re-exec as a clean success. They still BURN A TURN for floor purposes (below): the write\n  // was accepted, so we must assume the agent may have been re-invoked.\n  | 'psu-socket-reset-unconfirmed'\n  | 'psu-socket-recycle-unconfirmed'\n  | 'resume'\n  | 'resume-headless'\n  // An exited cold-loop owner starts a fresh context under its existing coord id.\n  | 'cold-fresh-successor'\n  // P-013 part A (review-system-rework-reduction-2026-09-23): every Claude account was\n  // walled, so the dead session was continued on Codex via a session port instead of\n  // resumed into the wall. Burns a turn like a resume.\n  | 'resume-rehome-backend'\n  // The Hive Queen is never resumed \u2014 her ended-session wake fires a FRESH hive\n  // launch (queen-brief-cache-assembly B-01 / P-012). Burns a turn like a resume.\n  | 'hive-fresh-wake'\n  // A drained bee warm-injected a NEW work-item is re-routed to a FRESH spawn instead\n  // of `--resume`-ing its grown transcript (bee-context-efficiency P-005 / D-018/D-021).\n  // Like hive-fresh-wake, it burns a turn (a fresh bee runs the task).\n  | 'fresh-context-warm-inject'\n  | 'plan-run-resume'\n  | 'inbox'\n  | 'coalesced'\n  // EI-18673058981655804 (redundant-inbox-wake-suppression): an always-armed\n  // inbox-wake (`coord:inbox-wake:<owner>`) whose triggering message(s) all\n  // predate the subscriber's own last coord:inbox/coord:orient read \u2014 the mail\n  // was already surfaced by the subscriber's own polling, so firing a turn for\n  // it would provably discover nothing new. Settled without ever calling\n  // executeWake (no liveness ladder, no spawn). Does NOT burn a turn, same as\n  // 'inbox'/'coalesced'.\n  | 'suppressed-redundant';\n\n/** The wake channels that actually burn a turn (re-invoke the agent) \u2014 used to derive a\n *  subscriber's `last_woken_at` for the floor. 'inbox'/'coalesced'/'suppressed-redundant'\n *  do NOT burn a turn. */\nexport const WAKE_TURN_CHANNELS: readonly WakeChannel[] = [\n  'pty-inject',\n  'psu-socket-inject',\n  'psu-socket-reset',\n  'psu-socket-recycle',\n  // WI-6862: an UNCONFIRMED reset/recycle must still count as a burned turn. The write was\n  // accepted, so the agent may well have been re-invoked; treating it as no-turn would let the\n  // floor re-wake the subscriber immediately and hammer a host that is very likely wedged.\n  'psu-socket-reset-unconfirmed',\n  'psu-socket-recycle-unconfirmed',\n  'resume',\n  'resume-headless',\n  'cold-fresh-successor',\n  'resume-rehome-backend',\n  'hive-fresh-wake',\n  'fresh-context-warm-inject',\n  'plan-run-resume',\n];\n\n/** Whether a settled channel attempted to re-invoke the subscriber's agent.\n *\n * `psu-socket-*-unconfirmed` remains true here: the host accepted the write, so\n * the channel burns wake budget even though the turn-start acknowledgement was\n * not observed. Inbox, coalesced, and redundant-suppression channels are\n * explicitly false because they settle without invoking a turn.\n */\nexport function wakeChannelInvokesTurn(channel: WakeChannel | null | undefined): boolean {\n  return channel != null && WAKE_TURN_CHANNELS.includes(channel);\n}\n\n/** A parked host still owns the delivery until its exact write/cancel/drop receipt.\n * New producers retain the accepted: marker. The deferred-busy-gate reason is\n * also host-owned: its original accepted write is waiting in the PTY re-arm.\n * Keep incumbent park reasons readable across deployment so a handled inbox\n * message cannot retire a queued host write. */\nexport const ACCEPTED_PSU_HOST_DELIVERY_PREFIXES = [\n  'psu-host accepted:',\n  'psu-host deferred-busy-gate:',\n  'psu-host pending-delivery-id:',\n  'psu-host coalesced-into-pending-turn:',\n  'psu-host accepted the cancellation request;',\n  'psu-host still owns the accepted delivery;',\n  'psu-host accepted the fail-open wake retry;',\n] as const;\n\nexport function isAcceptedPsuHostDelivery(delivery: Pick<DeliveryWork, 'lastError'>): boolean {\n  const reason = delivery.lastError ?? '';\n  return ACCEPTED_PSU_HOST_DELIVERY_PREFIXES.some((prefix) => reason.startsWith(prefix));\n}\n\nexport interface DeliveryRow {\n  id: number;\n  workspaceId: string;\n  awaitId: number;\n  subscriberId: string;\n  eventKey: string;\n  payload: unknown;\n  summary: string | null;\n  status: DeliveryStatus;\n  channel: WakeChannel | null;\n  attempts: number;\n  lastError: string | null;\n  nextAttemptAt: string;\n  createdAt: string;\n  deliveredAt: string | null;\n  /** Bypass the per-subscriber wake floor for this delivery (unify-watch-primitive P-005). */\n  urgent: boolean;\n  /** The floor (seconds) denormalized from the await, so the pump decides without a join.\n   *  null/0 = no floor. */\n  minSleepSec: number | null;\n  /** How many fires folded into this wake (1 = not coalesced). */\n  coalescedCount: number;\n  /** Emit-time attribution (migration 387) \u2014 e.g. a loop fire's `loop:<routineId>`. Persisted\n   *  so the async resume-turn-exit handler can attribute a turn DEATH to its source (the\n   *  loop-wake-rate-limit-robustness fix). null = unattributed. */\n  source: string | null;\n  /** P-006 / D-004 (migration 1441): did this delivery START A TURN \u2014 a question `status` does not\n   *  answer (`delivered` only means the delivery reached its channel). `host-attested` / `observed`\n   *  prove a turn; `awaiting` is unresolved until `pickupDeadlineAt`; `not-picked-up` is the\n   *  measured failure; `superseded` rode another delivery. null = booked before migration 1441:\n   *  UNKNOWN, never to be read as either outcome. */\n  turnProof: TurnProof | null;\n  /** When the turn-start proof was established (host attestation or first observed turn signal). */\n  turnStartedAt: string | null;\n  /** An `awaiting` delivery resolves to `not-picked-up` after this instant. */\n  pickupDeadlineAt: string | null;\n}\n\n/** EI-13705: the unconditional per-key \"did this ever genuinely fire\" latch\n *  (harness_shared.event_key_fires) \u2014 upserted on every real emit regardless\n *  of announce/waiters, so `events:status` can tell a key that fired but was\n *  never announced (`fired_undeclared`) apart from one that truly never has\n *  (`undeclared`), independent of how much time has passed since. */\nexport interface KeyFireRow {\n  workspaceId: string;\n  eventKey: string;\n  firstFiredAt: string;\n  lastFiredAt: string;\n  lastFiredBy: string | null;\n  lastPayload: unknown;\n  fireCount: number;\n}\n\n/** A delivery row joined with its await's wake handle + note (the pump's unit). */\nexport interface HostDeliveryCancellation {\n  /** Existing host delivery IDs that are still pending behind the host's gates. */\n  deliveryIds: string[];\n  /** Every inbox msg_id represented by the pending wake text. */\n  handledMsgIds: string[];\n}\n\n/** Ephemeral delivery-time evidence, populated by the canonical cell-read producer.\n * Event payloads never populate this field. */\nexport interface WakeCurrentMeasurement {\n  origin: 'canonical-cell-read';\n  status: 'value' | 'unknown';\n  measuredAt: string;\n  source: string;\n  summary: string;\n}\n\nexport interface DeliveryWork extends DeliveryRow {\n  wakeHandle: WakeHandle | null;\n  note: string | null;\n  /** Ephemeral proof-gated cancellation request; never persisted to the delivery row. */\n  hostCancellation?: HostDeliveryCancellation;\n  /** Delivery row to use for an inbox replay after stale loop components were removed. */\n  inboxDeliveryId?: number;\n  /** Ambient-push delivery rail (ambient-semantic-push P-003): a pre-rendered,\n   *  already-injection-door-capped teaser block that rides THIS wake's injection.\n   *  Populated ONLY when PAPERCUSP_AMBIENT_CURSOR is on (fail-soft, best-effort);\n   *  undefined on the default path \u21d2 the wake body is byte-identical. Appended by\n   *  wakeTurnText after its own line-collapse, so it flows through applyInjectionDoor\n   *  (the injection-door tally) with the rest of the wake text. */\n  ambientPushBlock?: string;\n  /**\n   * P-022 / D-007 \u2014 the subscribed cell's reading, resolved at TURN-ASSEMBLY time and\n   * stamped, for a `predicate:<id>` wake. Prepared in the async delivery path (never in\n   * the synchronous `wakeTurnText`) and absent whenever the delivery is not a\n   * cell-backed predicate fire or the reading could not be taken in budget.\n   */\n  cellWakeFoldBlock?: string;\n  currentStateMeasurement?: WakeCurrentMeasurement;\n  /**\n   * WI-6554700010018536 \u2014 for a `coord:inbox-wake:<owner>` delivery only: a one-line\n   * reminder of the recipient's held, unfinished work-items (and, in an autonomy mode\n   * with no loop armed, that nothing will wake it after this turn). Read at delivery\n   * time in the async path; absent when the recipient holds nothing or the read failed\n   * or ran out of budget \u21d2 the wake body is byte-identical.\n   */\n  inboxWakeHeldWorkReminder?: string;\n}\n\n/** The wake executor's verdict for one delivery attempt. */\nexport type WakeOutcome =\n  /** `turnProof` is set ONLY when the delivery itself proved a turn started (P-006/D-004):\n   *  the psu host's native-turn-start confirmation, or a confirmed quota-recovery pickup.\n   *  Absent \u21d2 the delivery reached its channel and the pump must still observe the turn. */\n  | { kind: 'delivered'; channel: WakeChannel; turnProof?: 'host-attested' }\n  /** Recipient alive but uninjectable (detached terminal) \u2014 re-check later;\n   *  converts to a resume when the process exits. */\n  | {\n      kind: 'park';\n      reason: string;\n      /** The psu host accepted this delivery id and still owns its detached gate pipeline. */\n      hostCommitPending?: true;\n    }\n  /** Dead waiter (D-004 net #2) \u2014 no liveness, nothing resumable. Visible. */\n  | { kind: 'drop'; reason: string }\n  | { kind: 'error'; error: string };\n","headBlobMatches":true},{"path":"packages/operator-core/lib/agent-launch-core.ts","sha256":"4ea0ba693b85acc6a54c256bf3c075dfe987fcce2789adb78c34971702b0a4b5","bytes":140351,"content":"/**\n * agent-launch-core \u2014 the ONE shared core for launching / resuming / forking\n * `psu` agent sessions from tools (agent-launch-resume-primitives-2026-07-12\n * P-001, D-001/D-002).\n *\n * `capability:terminal`, `capability:launch-agent` and `fleet:launch-on-plan`\n * consume these helpers instead of forking the spawn path:\n *   - the psu-command INJECTORS (fleet / launched-by / account) \u2014 targeted,\n *     idempotent rewrites of a raw command string, the capability:terminal\n *     arg-passing model the owner directed launch-agent to mimic;\n *   - the resume/fork RESOLVER (agent id OR native session id \u2192 the exact\n *     session to resume, with live-source detection so an in-place resume can\n *     never collide with a still-running CLI \u2014 WI-3882/D-007);\n *   - the post-resume KICKOFF INJECT (D-008): a resumed session boots idle and\n *     its presence rows are reaped, so roster-gated coord:wake cannot reach it \u2014\n *     the first turn is delivered through the psu pty-host discovery socket.\n */\nimport { hostname } from 'node:os';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\nimport { FRESH_VERIFY_TIMEOUT_MS } from './agent-kickoff/launch-budgets.mjs';\nimport { getOrgPg } from '@papercusp/db-org';\nimport { getAdvSession, mapAdvSessionRow, type AdvSessionRow, type AdvSessionEndedBy, type AdvSessionExpectedBinding } from './adv-sessions';\nimport { getSessionPort } from './session-port/store';\nimport type { SessionBackend, SessionPortContractSummary } from './session-port/types';\nimport {\n  findLiveHost,\n  findLiveHostAsync,\n  injectIntoHost,\n  readHostEventTail,\n  type PsuPtyHost,\n  type PtyHostEvent,\n} from './events/await/psu-pty-discovery';\nimport { fetchSelfWake } from './agent-tools/coordination/presence-selfwake';\nimport {\n  accountFromArgv,\n  composeLaunchModelSpec,\n  flagValueFromArgv,\n  isLaunchAccountValue,\n  MIN_COMPACTION_LIMIT_TOKENS,\n  modelSpecFromArgv,\n  MODEL_EFFORT_LEVELS,\n  normalizeModelSpec,\n} from './agent-config-constants';\nimport { resolveCodexModel, resolveCodexModelSelection } from './model-context-budget.mjs';\nimport { isSuAgent, SU_AGENTS } from './su-agents';\nimport { tagTurnForInjection } from './turn-provenance/turn-provenance';\n\nimport { ISSUE_FAMILY_ROUTE_KINDS, type IssueFamilyRouteKind } from './work-nature/agent-work-predicate';\nexport type CodexModelSource = 'explicit' | 'inherited' | 'configured-default';\n\n/** Match `psu` as a command token \u2014 start of line, or after whitespace / a\n *  shell separator \u2014 followed by whitespace. Shared by every injector. */\nconst PSU_TOKEN = /(^|[\\s&;|(])psu(\\s)/;\n\n/**\n * Is this terminal command actually an AGENT LAUNCH wearing a command's clothes?\n * (P-004 \u2014 the wrong-door guard.)\n *\n * WHY THE DOOR MATTERS, and why this is not pedantry: `capability:terminal` is the\n * arbitrary-COMMAND door and hardcodes `preferProcessPerWindow: true`, which\n * resolves to a process-per-window emulator. `capability:launch-agent` keeps\n * that reliability default unless an explicit `$TERMINAL` preference is set,\n * so the configured terminal wins for visible launches. Both doors share ONE\n * spawn path \u2014 the divergence is emulator POLICY, not mechanism \u2014 but a\n * launch through the wrong door lands in a different window manager, skips the\n * backend preflight (P-002) and the started-verification (P-003), and is exactly\n * how the owner's two failed omp launches happened.\n *\n * DELIBERATELY NARROW. `psu --help`, `psu --version`, `psu-sentinel`, and any\n * `psu` mention inside a longer word are NOT launches and must keep working \u2014 a\n * guard that over-refuses teaches agents to route around it, which is worse than\n * no guard. The positive test is a `psu` COMMAND TOKEN (the same boundary rule\n * every injector uses) that is not one of the informational flags.\n */\nexport function classifyAgentLaunchCommand(command: string): {\n  isAgentLaunch: boolean;\n  mode: 'fresh' | 'resume' | null;\n} {\n  if (!PSU_TOKEN.test(command ?? '')) return { isAgentLaunch: false, mode: null };\n  // Informational invocations print and exit \u2014 no agent, no window to supervise.\n  if (/(^|\\s)--(help|version)(\\s|$|=)/.test(command)) return { isAgentLaunch: false, mode: null };\n  const resume = /(^|\\s)--(resume|fork)(=|\\s|$)/.test(command);\n  return { isAgentLaunch: true, mode: resume ? 'resume' : 'fresh' };\n}\n\n/**\n * named-su-agent-fleets / EI-5835: when the caller passes an explicit `fleet`, a\n * `psu \u2026` launch inside a terminal command should JOIN that fleet \u2014 not merely\n * inherit its colour. The `fleet` arg alone is COLOUR-ONLY (it tints the window);\n * fleet MEMBERSHIP comes from psu's own `--fleet=<slug>` flag. Agents repeatedly\n * set `fleet` and forget `--fleet`, so members spawn with `fleetSlug:null` AND miss\n * the launcher's fleet auto-kickoff (they park). Auto-inject `--fleet=<slug>` into a\n * psu command that lacks it so colour and membership can't diverge. Non-psu commands,\n * and commands already carrying `--fleet`, are left untouched.\n */\nexport function injectFleetArg(\n  command: string,\n  fleetSlug: string | null,\n): { command: string; injected: boolean } {\n  if (!fleetSlug) return { command, injected: false };\n  if (/(^|\\s)--fleet(=|\\s|$)/.test(command)) return { command, injected: false };\n  if (!PSU_TOKEN.test(command)) return { command, injected: false };\n  return { command: command.replace(PSU_TOKEN, `$1psu --fleet=${fleetSlug}$2`), injected: true };\n}\n\n/**\n * solo-launch-provenance (the EI-5835 pattern, applied to WHO-launched-you): a `psu \u2026`\n * launch spawned from a tool should carry `--launched-by=<caller ownerId>` so\n * bootstrap-su can bake the provenance into the launched session (system prompt +\n * PAPERCUSP_LAUNCHED_BY + an owner-scoped standing fact). Without it a solo-launched\n * agent has NO way to answer \"who launched / supervises you\" \u2014 su-8ab32510\n * (2026-07-03) described its launcher as \"an observer who doesn't assign or\n * supervise my work\". Commands already carrying the flag, and non-psu commands,\n * are left untouched. The ownerId is injected into a shell string, so only\n * identity-shaped values are accepted.\n */\nexport function injectLaunchedByArg(\n  command: string,\n  launcherOwnerId: string | null,\n): { command: string; injected: boolean } {\n  if (!launcherOwnerId || !/^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,120}$/.test(launcherOwnerId)) {\n    return { command, injected: false };\n  }\n  if (/(^|\\s)--launched-by(=|\\s|$)/.test(command)) return { command, injected: false };\n  if (!PSU_TOKEN.test(command)) return { command, injected: false };\n  return {\n    command: command.replace(PSU_TOKEN, `$1psu --launched-by=${launcherOwnerId}$2`),\n    injected: true,\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Account pinning for SCRIPTED launches (P-012, owner-hit 2026-07-12): a psu\n * launch/resume with no `--account` prompts an INTERACTIVE account picker\n * (chooseResumeAccount), which blocks a tool-spawned session until a human\n * answers it. Inject `--account=default` (or the caller's explicit account \u2014\n * `default` | `auto` | a pool account id, the account-routing-3-options\n * grammar) into any psu command that lacks one. Value-guarded: an account id\n * lands in a shell string, so only identity-shaped values are accepted.\n */\nexport function injectAccountArg(\n  command: string,\n  account: string | null = 'default',\n): { command: string; injected: boolean } {\n  if (!account || !/^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,120}$/.test(account)) return { command, injected: false };\n  if (/(^|\\s)--account(=|\\s|$)/.test(command)) return { command, injected: false };\n  if (!PSU_TOKEN.test(command)) return { command, injected: false };\n  return { command: command.replace(PSU_TOKEN, `$1psu --account=${account}$2`), injected: true };\n}\n\n/**\n * Launch-time mode overlay carried across a scripted spawn boundary.\n *\n * Keep this payload\n * deliberately small and closed: a caller may propagate the leader's durable\n * mode row + standing instructions, but it must never smuggle arbitrary mode\n * prose or an unbounded value into a shell command / bootstrap body.\n */\nexport type LaunchModeId = 'drain' | 'grade' | 'test';\n\nexport const LAUNCH_MODE_SUBJECT_MAX_CHARS = 200;\nexport const LAUNCH_MODE_INSTRUCTIONS_MAX_CHARS = 500;\n\nexport interface LaunchMode {\n  mode: LaunchModeId;\n  subject: string | null;\n  instructions: string | null;\n  ownerDirected: boolean;\n}\n\nfunction boundedLaunchModeText(value: unknown, maxChars: number): string | null {\n  if (typeof value !== 'string') return null;\n  const text = value.trim().slice(0, maxChars);\n  return text || null;\n}\n\n/** Normalize an untrusted launch-mode value before it reaches argv or JSON. */\nexport function normalizeLaunchMode(value: unknown, opts: { fleetRole?: 'member' | 'leader' } = {}): LaunchMode | null {\n  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return null;\n  const input = value as Record<string, unknown>;\n  if (input.mode !== 'drain' && input.mode !== 'grade' && input.mode !== 'test') return null;\n  // A new member can participate in the caller's mode, but the caller's\n  // personal mission and owner-directed provenance do not belong to that identity.\n  const member = opts.fleetRole === 'member';\n  return {\n    mode: input.mode,\n    subject: member ? null : boundedLaunchModeText(input.subject, LAUNCH_MODE_SUBJECT_MAX_CHARS),\n    instructions: member ? null : boundedLaunchModeText(input.instructions, LAUNCH_MODE_INSTRUCTIONS_MAX_CHARS),\n    ownerDirected: !member && input.ownerDirected === true,\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Resolve the launch overlay from the caller's durable mode row and standing\n * fact. The inputs are intentionally structural so this shared core stays\n * client-safe; callers read `agent_modes` / `mode-instructions:drain` once and\n * hand the bounded result to every launch composer.\n */\nexport function resolveLaunchMode(opts: {\n  modeRows?: ReadonlyArray<{\n    mode?: unknown;\n    subject?: unknown;\n    ownerDirected?: unknown;\n  }>;\n  instructionsFact?: unknown;\n}): LaunchMode | null {\n  const drain = opts.modeRows?.find((row) => row?.mode === 'drain');\n  if (!drain) return null;\n  return normalizeLaunchMode({\n    mode: 'drain',\n    subject: drain.subject,\n    instructions: opts.instructionsFact,\n    ownerDirected: drain.ownerDirected,\n  });\n}\n\n/**\n * The member launch mode a fleet's persisted recipe declares (`config.mode`).\n * Member-shaped on purpose: the founding caller's subject, instructions and\n * owner-directed provenance are personal to that identity, so a recipe replay\n * carries only the mode itself (WI-6554700010029298).\n */\nexport function launchModeFromFleetRecipe(config: { mode?: unknown } | null | undefined): LaunchMode | null {\n  if (!config || config.mode !== 'drain') return null;\n  return normalizeLaunchMode({ mode: 'drain' }, { fleetRole: 'member' });\n}\n\n/** A resume/fork target fully resolved to the exact session to act on. */\nexport interface ResumeTarget {\n  /**\n   * The native CLI session uuid, when the backend recorded one.\n   *\n   * Tracked Codex rows can predate native-id registration; in that case this is\n   * null and {@link resumeId} carries the tracked adv_sessions row id instead.\n   */\n  sessionId: string | null;\n  /** OMP's native thread/session handle; OMP rows do not use sessionId. */\n  ompThreadId: string | null;\n  /**\n   * The selector accepted by `psu --resume`: the native session id when known,\n   * otherwise the tracked adv_sessions row id for a Codex session.\n   */\n  resumeId: string;\n  /** The session's coord identity \u2014 the pty-host discovery key + the identity an\n   *  in-place resume re-attaches. */\n  ownerId: string | null;\n  /** Workspace recorded on the exact adv_sessions source row. */\n  workspaceId: string | null;\n  /** Harness recorded in the exact source launch argv; absent argv stays unknown. */\n  harnessSlug: string | null;\n  agent: string | null;\n  /** Persona role recorded on the source session; null means the standard SU role. */\n  role: string | null;\n  /** Feature/work item recorded on the source session, when one was bound. */\n  feature: string | null;\n  cwd: string | null;\n  /** The model spec recorded in the source session's launch argv, when present. */\n  model: string | null;\n  /** The Codex model-source provenance recorded in launch argv, when present. */\n  modelSource: CodexModelSource | null;\n  /** The account route recorded in the source session's launch argv, when present. */\n  account: string | null;\n  /** Recorded terminal placement; used by recovery paths that forbid caller overrides. */\n  headless?: boolean;\n  /** Local terminal process handle, when the source launch recorded one. Used only by\n   * hostless recovery after an explicit local-liveness probe; never treated as an\n   * owner identity on its own. */\n  pid?: number | null;\n  /** Launch display provenance. `terminal` is local by construction; other values\n   * are not safe to probe as a hostless source. */\n  display?: string | null;\n  /** \u26a0 Only an end time when {@link endedBy} is `'self'`. Otherwise a sweeper stamped it on\n   *  NOTICING the process was gone, so it cannot answer \"when did this session end\". */\n  endedAt: string | null;\n  /** Who wrote {@link endedAt} (migration 735). `null` = legacy row, provenance UNKNOWN \u2014\n   *  which is not the same as a clean self-reported exit. */\n  endedBy: AdvSessionEndedBy | null;\n  /** A live pty host currently serves this identity \u2014 an in-place resume would\n   *  collide (WI-3882/WI-3455); the caller must fork instead (D-007). */\n  live: boolean;\n  advSessionId: number;\n  /** The persisted incarnation, which may differ from an exact transcript pin. */\n  binding: AdvSessionExpectedBinding | null;\n  /** The row's session-port status (null = not a port target). psu refuses to\n   *  resume or fork the row unless portStatusAllowsResume(portStatus) holds. */\n  portStatus?: string | null;\n}\n\n/** Server-only guard carried through an internal projected successor dispatch. */\nexport const INTERNAL_EXPECTED_SUCCESSOR_BINDING: unique symbol = Symbol('internal-expected-successor-binding');\nexport interface InternalExpectedSuccessorBinding {\n  ownerId: string;\n  advSessionId: number;\n  workspaceId: string;\n  harnessSlug: string;\n  binding: AdvSessionExpectedBinding;\n  requirePositiveTerminalEvidence?: boolean;\n}\n\nexport type ResolveResumeError =\n  | { ok: false; error: 'not_found'; detail: string }\n  | { ok: false; error: 'no_native_session_id'; detail: string };\n\nexport type ResolveResumeResult = ({ ok: true } & ResumeTarget) | ResolveResumeError;\n\n/** Read the model and account settings that a resume must carry from launch argv. */\nfunction resumeLaunchMetadata(\n  launchArgv: unknown,\n): Pick<ResumeTarget, 'model' | 'modelSource' | 'account' | 'harnessSlug'> {\n  const source = flagValueFromArgv(launchArgv, 'model-source');\n  const account = accountFromArgv(launchArgv);\n  return {\n    model: modelSpecFromArgv(launchArgv),\n    modelSource:\n      source === 'explicit' || source === 'inherited' || source === 'configured-default'\n        ? source\n        : null,\n    account: account && isLaunchAccountValue(account) ? account : null,\n    harnessSlug: flagValueFromArgv(launchArgv, 'harness')?.trim() || null,\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Pick the native transcript id a resume command must receive.\n *\n * `requestedSessionId` is an EXACT native UUID contract. The resolver may use\n * `session_turns` to recover that rollout's logical owner and then read the\n * owner's `adv_sessions` row for cwd/agent/liveness metadata, but that owner row\n * can legitimately carry an OLDER root UUID. Substituting the row UUID silently\n * rewinds the conversation \u2014 the 2026-08-20 restoration incident did exactly\n * that for two Codex sessions. The explicitly requested UUID therefore always\n * wins; only an owner/agent-id lookup uses the row's recorded native UUID.\n */\nexport function resolvedNativeSessionId(\n  requestedSessionId: string | null | undefined,\n  recordedSessionId: string | null | undefined,\n): string | null {\n  return requestedSessionId?.trim() || recordedSessionId?.trim() || null;\n}\n\n/**\n * The minimum measured quiet period before an agent-launched headless host may\n * be treated as a recoverable husk. Keep this deliberately longer than a normal\n * wake interval: a quiet loop-armed worker is still a live identity, and only a\n * host with explicit agent provenance is eligible for replacement.\n */\nexport const STALE_HEADLESS_AGENT_HOST_IDLE_MS = 30 * 60_000;\n\n/**\n * Is a discovered host safe to replace during an ordinary exact resume?\n *\n * A process-alive host is normally a live source and must be forked. The one\n * narrow recovery exception is an explicitly headless host launched by another\n * agent whose pty activity is measured and has been idle for the recovery\n * threshold. Missing provenance, missing activity, interactive hosts, and\n * recent hosts all fail closed to the normal live-source fork behavior.\n * Pure and injectable so the launch guard can be regression-tested without a\n * real pty host or wall-clock timing.\n */\nexport function isStaleHeadlessAgentHost(\n  host: Pick<PsuPtyHost, 'bridgeTty' | 'launchedBy' | 'lastActivityAt' | 'lastInputAt' | 'lastOutputAt'> | null | undefined,\n  {\n    now = Date.now(),\n    idleThresholdMs = STALE_HEADLESS_AGENT_HOST_IDLE_MS,\n  }: { now?: number; idleThresholdMs?: number } = {},\n): boolean {\n  if (host?.bridgeTty !== false || !String(host?.launchedBy ?? '').trim()) return false;\n  const activitySamples = [host.lastActivityAt, host.lastOutputAt, host.lastInputAt]\n    .map((value) => Number(value))\n    .filter((value) => Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0);\n  const threshold = Number(idleThresholdMs);\n  if (!activitySamples.length || !Number.isFinite(threshold) || threshold <= 0) return false;\n  const lastActivityAt = Math.max(...activitySamples);\n  return Number.isFinite(now) && now >= lastActivityAt && now - lastActivityAt >= threshold;\n}\n\n/**\n * Resume/fork RESOLVER (P-004, D-004): given an AGENT id (`su-\u2026`) or a native\n * CLI session uuid, resolve the most-recent matching `adv_sessions` row so a\n * caller never hunts a transcript uuid by hand \u2014 and detect a still-LIVE\n * source (via the pty-host discovery dir) so the caller forks instead of\n * colliding in place (D-007).\n */\nexport async function resolveResumeTarget(ref: {\n  agentId?: string | null;\n  sessionId?: string | null;\n}): Promise<ResolveResumeResult> {\n  const agentId = ref.agentId?.trim() || null;\n  const sessionId = ref.sessionId?.trim() || null;\n  if (!agentId && !sessionId) {\n    return { ok: false, error: 'not_found', detail: 'pass resume.agentId or resume.sessionId' };\n  }\n  const { sql } = getOrgPg();\n  // Exact-pin by native session id wins; otherwise start with the newest row for\n  // the requested agent id by immutable registration id, not mutable started_at.\n  // A predecessor's start timestamp can be refreshed during reconciliation;\n  // that must never promote it above its successor, even after the successor ends.\n  // A carry-respawn can rotate the coord owner while\n  // retaining the transcript's native session id, so agent-id lookup must follow\n  // that candidate session through the latest session_turns.owner and prefer the\n  // current adv_sessions row. Without that bridge, a stale historical owner is\n  // handed to the reviver even though its live successor is already running.\n  // An agentId may be a PREFIX (the short `su-b0fbf` handle agents actually say\n  // out loud) \u2014 match by prefix, newest registration first. adv_sessions is deliberately NOT\n  // workspace-scoped here: coord_owner_id and session_id are globally unique\n  // (see advSessionsByCoordOwner's note), so a workspace predicate could only\n  // drop valid rows.\n  //\n  // An exact native-session pin is its OWN candidate, and must NOT be looked up\n  // through adv_sessions first (WI-555403). A carry-respawn REWRITES the owner's\n  // adv_sessions row in place \u2014 same row id, new session_id + started_at (see\n  // reanchorAdvSessionNativeId in adv-sessions.ts) \u2014 so every EARLIER session in\n  // a respawn chain has no adv_sessions row at all. Seeding `candidate` from\n  // adv_sessions therefore left indexed_owner NULL for exactly those sessions,\n  // the final predicate degenerated to `coord_owner_id = NULL`, and an earlier\n  // transcript resolved as not_found even though session_turns still holds it\n  // under the same owner. Taking the pin directly lets indexed_owner bridge it\n  // back to the owner's CURRENT row; resolvedNativeSessionId below still returns\n  // the requested uuid, so the pin is never replaced by that row's newer one.\n  const rows = await sql<Array<Parameters<typeof mapAdvSessionRow>[0] & { binding_started_at: string }>>`\n    WITH candidate AS (\n      ${\n        sessionId\n          ? sql`SELECT ${sessionId}::text AS candidate_session_id`\n          : sql`SELECT CASE WHEN s.agent = 'omp' THEN COALESCE(s.omp_thread_id, s.session_id)\n                            ELSE s.session_id END AS candidate_session_id\n                  FROM harness_shared.adv_sessions s\n                 WHERE s.coord_owner_id LIKE ${agentId + '%'}\n                 ORDER BY s.id DESC\n                 LIMIT 1`\n      }\n    ),\n    indexed_owner AS (\n      SELECT t.owner\n        FROM harness_shared.session_turns t\n       WHERE t.session_id = (SELECT candidate_session_id FROM candidate)\n         AND t.owner IS NOT NULL\n       ORDER BY t.ingested_at DESC\n       LIMIT 1\n    )\n    -- Headless psu launches record their own process liveness on coord_presence\n    -- from the supervisor beat, while bootstrap cannot know that pid yet. Use\n    -- that live same-host witness only when the launch is explicitly headless;\n    -- interactive rows keep their durable adv_sessions pid semantics. The\n    -- presence row is TTL-reaped and the host equality prevents probing a\n    -- remote pid from this operator process.\n    SELECT s.id, s.workspace_id, s.plan_slug, s.agent, s.role, s.feature, s.mode, s.terminal_bin,\n           COALESCE(\n             s.pid,\n             CASE WHEN s.launch_argv ? '--headless' THEN (\n               SELECT p.pid\n                 FROM harness_shared.coord_presence p\n                WHERE p.owner_id = s.coord_owner_id\n                  AND p.workspace_id = s.workspace_id\n                  AND p.host = ${hostname()}\n                  AND p.pid IS NOT NULL\n                LIMIT 1\n             ) END\n           ) AS pid,\n           s.window_id, s.omp_thread_id, s.label, s.cwd, s.coord_owner_id, s.session_id, s.display, s.started_at, s.ended_at, s.exit_code,\n           s.ended_by, s.launch_argv, s.started_at::text AS binding_started_at\n      FROM harness_shared.adv_sessions s\n     WHERE ${\n       sessionId\n         ? sql`session_id = ${sessionId}\n                 OR (agent = 'omp' AND omp_thread_id = ${sessionId})\n                 OR coord_owner_id = (SELECT owner FROM indexed_owner)`\n         : sql`coord_owner_id LIKE ${agentId + '%'}\n                 OR coord_owner_id = (SELECT owner FROM indexed_owner)`\n     }\n     ORDER BY ${\n       sessionId\n         ? sql`(session_id = ${sessionId}) DESC,`\n         : sql`(coord_owner_id = (SELECT owner FROM indexed_owner)) DESC,`\n     } id DESC\n     LIMIT 1\n  `;\n  if (!rows.length) {\n    return {\n      ok: false,\n      error: 'not_found',\n      detail: sessionId\n        ? `no adv_sessions row records native session ${sessionId}, and session_turns holds no owner ` +\n          'for it either \u2014 check the uuid (sessions:list)'\n        : `no adv_sessions row for agent ${agentId} \u2014 check the id (coord:presence / sessions:list)`,\n    };\n  }\n  const row: AdvSessionRow = mapAdvSessionRow(rows[0]);\n  const nativeSessionId = resolvedNativeSessionId(sessionId, row.agent === 'omp' ? row.ompThreadId ?? row.sessionId : row.sessionId);\n  const launchMetadata = resumeLaunchMetadata(row.launchArgv);\n  // The psu launcher already supports tracked Codex rows with no native UUID:\n  // `psu --resume=<adv row id>` resolves the row, restores its isolated\n  // CODEX_HOME, and runs `codex resume --last`. Other backends need a native\n  // transcript handle, so preserve their fail-closed error.\n  if (!nativeSessionId && row.agent !== 'codex') {\n    return {\n      ok: false,\n      error: 'no_native_session_id',\n      detail:\n        `adv session #${row.id} (${row.coordOwnerId ?? 'no coord id'}, agent ${row.agent ?? '?'}) carries no ` +\n        'native session uuid \u2014 it predates native-id tracking or is an omp thread; resume it by hand ' +\n        '(`psu --resume` picker) instead.',\n    };\n  }\n  const host: PsuPtyHost | null = row.coordOwnerId ? await findLiveHostAsync(row.coordOwnerId) : null;\n  return {\n    ok: true,\n    // Exact native UUID pins are never replaced by the logical owner's older\n    // adv_sessions.session_id. session_turns supplies owner METADATA only.\n    sessionId: nativeSessionId,\n    // OMP transcript readers use this alias ahead of sessionId. String(row.id),\n    ownerId: row.coordOwnerId,\n    workspaceId: row.workspaceId?.trim() || null,\n    agent: row.agent,\n    role: row.role,\n    feature: row.feature,\n    cwd: row.cwd,\n    ...launchMetadata,\n    pid: row.pid,\n    display: row.display,\n    headless: row.launchArgv?.includes('--headless') === true,\n    endedAt: row.endedAt,\n    endedBy: row.endedBy,\n    live: host != null,\n    advSessionId: row.id,\n    portStatus: row.portStatus ?? null,\n    binding: row.coordOwnerId && rows[0].binding_started_at ? {\n      coordOwnerId: row.coordOwnerId,\n      sessionId: row.sessionId,\n      ...(row.agent === 'omp' ? { ompThreadId: row.ompThreadId } : {}),\n      startedAt: rows[0].binding_started_at,\n    } : null,\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Compose the scripted `psu` command for launch-agent (P-003/P-005). ever builds fresh\n   * launches, so there is no resume case to guard here).\n   *\n   * goal-mode-hardening P-009 (NOT the leader-compaction-reseed P-009 that other\n   * comments in (low|medium|high|xhigh|max) when not baked into the model spec. */\n  effort?: string;\n  feature?: string;\n  launchContext?: string;\n  /** Durable launch-mode overlay inherited from the launching
